name: const unsafe fn transmute < Src , Dst > (src : Src) -> Dst
rule: In a const context, a pointer must not be transmuted to an integer unless the pointer was originally created from an integer. This also applies when the integer is nested inside an array, tuple, struct, or enum. MaybeUninit<usize> is not considered an integer for this restriction, but calling assume_init() on the result of transmuting a pointer to MaybeUninit<usize> completes the pointer-to-integer transmutation and is subject to the restriction.
api: const unsafe fn transmute < Src , Dst > (src : Src) -> Dst
